name: Blast-Furnace Hellkite
oracle_text:
Artifact offering (You may cast this spell as though it had flash by sacrificing an artifact and paying the difference in mana costs between this and the sacrificed artifact. Mana cost includes color.)
Flying, double strike
Creatures attacking your opponents have double strike.
blocked_sentences: Artifact offering (You may cast this spell as though it had flash by sacrificing an artifact and paying the difference in mana costs between this and the sacrificed artifact. Mana cost includes color.)
Creatures attacking your opponents have double strike.

needs.what: an optional card-level alternative way to cast (702.48, '<Type> offering') parameterised by a permanent filter (here types: [Artifact]): the caster sacrifices one matching permanent they control as the spell is cast, the spell may then be cast any time they could cast an instant, and its total cost is reduced by the sacrificed permanent's mana cost symbol by symbol, coloured symbols included ({7}{R}{R} minus a {1}{R} artifact leaves {6}{R}), with the sacrificed object's mana cost read as the cost is locked in
needs.why_existing_wont_do: emerge is the closest: it sacrifices a creature and reduces by mana VALUE as generic only, and grants no flash timing; as_though_flash / flash_cost give instant timing but take no sacrifice and no cost reduction keyed to the sacrificed object; additional_cost with sacrifice plus cost_reduction cannot read the sacrificed object's coloured mana cost, and cost_reduction_keys only reduce generic

needs.what: a static affects-filter key meaning 'attacking one of the source controller's opponents' (the defending player of the creature's attack is an opponent of the static's controller, not a planeswalker or battle), for a grant_keyword static over creatures of any controller
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_affects_filter_keys has `attacking`, but the engine reads it as a boolean (selectors.py / characteristics.py compare bool(combat.attacking(oid))), so it would also grant double strike to an opponent's creatures attacking you and to creatures attacking planeswalkers; `defending`/`attacking` binding forms exist only on token-creation ops, not static filters
